mission: Make authorized connected services and owner-provided media discoverable to Buddy's learning and benchmark pipelines.

sources.label: GitHub repository and Actions evidence
sources.ingestion: repository metadata, code, issues, pull requests, workflow logs and artifacts
sources.learning_output: versioned tasks, tests, failure records and benchmark evidence

sources.label: Connected ChatGPT apps
sources.ingestion: app-specific, owner-authorized records through the available connector
sources.learning_output: source references, task context and user-approved study packets

sources.label: OpenAI developer tools
sources.ingestion: model and API documentation, evaluations and authorized application traces
sources.permission: configured developer project and scoped key reference
sources.learning_output: model-selection evidence and reproducible evaluation definitions

sources.label: Hugging Face models, datasets and papers
sources.ingestion: licensed model cards, datasets, papers and spaces
sources.learning_output: provenance records, benchmark candidates and local-model evaluation tasks

sources.label: Figma designs and design systems
sources.ingestion: owner-authorized design context, tokens and code-connect mappings
sources.learning_output: UI requirements, visual regression fixtures and implementation tasks

sources.label: Adobe creative and document tools
sources.ingestion: owner-authorized assets, OCR, document and media metadata
sources.permission: selected assets and explicit edit actions
sources.learning_output: rights-aware media metadata, transformations and quality checks

sources.label: Canva brand and design tools
sources.ingestion: authorized brand kits, templates and design metadata
sources.learning_output: brand constraints and reviewable creative briefs

sources.label: Web research and extraction
sources.ingestion: authorized public-web search, scrape and research outputs
sources.permission: site terms, robots policy and connector authorization
sources.learning_output: cited research records and benchmark source candidates

sources.label: Supabase development services
sources.ingestion: approved schemas, migrations and service metadata
sources.permission: selected project with least-privilege database access
sources.learning_output: schema tests, migration plans and data-contract evidence

sources.label: Deployment platforms
sources.ingestion: authorized build, deploy, runtime and log evidence
sources.permission: selected project and read-first operational scopes
sources.learning_output: deployment checks, incident evidence and recovery tasks

sources.label: Apple Intelligence video exports
sources.ingestion: owner-exported videos, transcripts and metadata from an Apple device
sources.permission: explicit local file selection; no device-wide media access
sources.learning_output: authorized video analysis through the repository video pipeline, timestamped observations and benchmark fixtures

truth_rule: An adapter-ready source is discoverable but not connected to a live account. Buddy may learn only from lawful, licensed, public or owner-authorized inputs with provenance and evaluation evidence.
